newsitem.title: JAPAN: Romanian central bank to launch samurai next week.
newsitem.headline: Romanian central bank to launch samurai next week.

text.p: The Romanian central bank is likely to launch samurai bonds, possibly sometime next week, underwriting sources said on Friday.
They said volume was expected to be about 30 billion yen, with a duration of five years.

A major Japanese brokerage house will act as lead manager. Many brokerages are eager to participate as syndicate members because Romania's first samurai bonds launched in May were well received by the market at that time, they said.
The bank in May launched 52 billion yen of 5.2 percent three-year samurais, lead managed by Nomura Securities.
